rules.description: No duplicate resolved App Router page routes
rules.reason: Duplicate routes break navigation and confuse ownership.

rules.description: Engine/UI/db independence boundaries must hold
rules.reason: UI must not import engine or database internals.

rules.description: Product authority and APS pointer stubs must be valid
rules.reason: Hard knowledge authority failures mean the living system cannot be trusted.

rules.description: Features must not deep-import another feature’s internals
rules.reason: Cross-feature coupling must go through declared public APIs.

rules.description: Declared public API entrypoints must exist
rules.reason: Independence requires an explicit public surface.

rules.description: No circular dependencies in src import graph
rules.reason: Cycles prevent clean ownership and safe refactors.

rules.description: Source files should stay under the agreed line threshold
rules.reason: Oversized files hide mixed responsibilities.

rules.description: Files should not mix many architectural layers
rules.reason: UI + engine + db + server in one file is a responsibility smell.

rules.description: Modules should not expose an excessive public surface
rules.reason: Too many exports usually means mixed jobs.

rules.description: Structural src paths must have an owner
rules.reason: Unowned paths drift without a responsible surface.

rules.description: Ownership exceptions must not be expired
rules.reason: Expired exceptions silently hide real ownership debt.

rules.description: Generated knowledge maps/indexes must match the tree
rules.reason: Stale maps are worse than no maps.

rules.description: CURRENT_STATE last_verified must be within the freshness window
rules.reason: Agents must know what is live vs mocked.

rules.description: Qualifying feature roots need FEATURES briefs
rules.reason: Meaningful surfaces need a short intent doc.

rules.description: TypeScript strict mode enabled
rules.reason: Strict typing catches boundary bugs early.

rules.description: ESLint config is present
rules.reason: Shared lint rules keep mechanical quality consistent.

rules.description: TypeScript compile must pass
rules.reason: A project with type errors cannot be 10/10.

rules.description: Lint must pass
rules.reason: Lint failures block a perfect code-quality score.

rules.description: No extreme oversized source files (>2× threshold)
rules.reason: Extreme size usually means multiple jobs in one file.

rules.description: Knowledge route resolver tests pass
rules.reason: Route maps are foundational.

rules.description: CI knowledge-check workflow exists
rules.reason: Without CI, knowledge drift lands silently.

rules.description: Feature-level tests exist under src/
rules.reason: Critical flows need meaningful assertions.

rules.description: npm test suite must pass
rules.reason: Failing tests block a perfect testing score.

rules.description: .env.example must exist
rules.reason: Onboarding needs a documented env surface.

rules.description: Referenced process.env keys should appear in .env.example
rules.reason: Undocumented env vars hide required configuration.

rules.description: Secret-like names must not use NEXT_PUBLIC_
rules.reason: Browser-exposed secrets are a hard security failure.

rules.description: Client components must not import server-only modules
rules.reason: Leaks server/db into the browser bundle.

aiAdvisory.note: AI findings are advisory only and never alter officialScore.
